ladaf-2021-17.scope: Local sensitivity grid, not a global search or perceptually validated optimum. Image review selects the published profiles; the grid checks nearby tradeoffs.
ladaf-2021-17.caveat: Both signal and noise may contribute to local source-pair contrast. More tones or contrast do not establish finer spatial resolution or anatomical correctness.
